title: Canvas2d gumball meta layer
description: 🧭️ The `meta:gumball` layer a plugin puts into its Canvas2d scene to arm the host gumball — React `Canvas2dGumballOverlay` and its wgpu twin `canvas2d_gumball` read it the same way. Hosts paint the handles at `pivotLayer`, map pointer motion back to model units through `modelToLayer` and dispatch `translateSelection` / `rotateSelection` / `scaleSelection` over the `selectionIds` pinned at pointer-down.

active.description: Only an active gumball is painted.

liveDispatch.description: true: the app previews the open gesture itself, so hosts stream it — `phase: stream` per pointer move, `commit` on release, `abort{reason}` on cancel. false: hosts preview locally and dispatch ONE one-shot pose delta (no `phase`) on release; a cancel dispatches nothing.

pivotLayer.description: The pivot in layer (world) units — where the handles are painted and what a turn or scaling is measured about.

ModelToLayer.description: The affine map from model to layer units, per axis: layer = model × scale + offset. Absent = identity (the app's model IS its layer space).
